summary: Batch defaults by usage context and GPU (H100 8192/1024 serve, 16384/1024 LLM; A100 2048/256, 8192/256; B200 16384/1024), throughput doubling, no-chunked 131072, and CUDA graph ceiling 512/256 all reproduced; the world already deploys 8192/1024 (benchmark preamble wrong).

EOS/stop-id/length outcomes right; check-stop lacks the min_tokens gate and repetition detection (no FINISHED_REPETITION, min_count validation absent); _all_stop_token_ids not represented. Corrected: min_count 1 is a 400.

Publisher defaults to null instead of zmq when events are enabled; BlockStored counts/timing right but fields (parent, token_ids, block_size, medium, lora) missing and hashes are strings; kv_cache_report_mode full and AllBlocksCleared not modeled.

Hit lengths and encoder skipping reproduced via a stand-in key; no (mm, id, offset) key, fixed 256 placeholders per image, mm hash over URL not decoded content, uuid re-hashed rather than used verbatim; init_none_hash orphaned and warning text absent.

Encoder cache across preemption reproduced (freeable but cached, 2048 hit + 352 with no re-encode, C evicts I, A schedules 0). Setup corrected: under FCFS a KV-blocked A blocks C; needs priority policy.
FP8 weights 8.46 vs 14.96 GiB, bf16 KV 2 MiB blocks, +3,328 blocks reproduced; startup log lines not modeled; ModelOpt kv_cache_quant_algo FP8 does not resolve auto to fp8_e4m3 (stays 2-byte).
DP4+EP default 8192/1024 and KV specs (32 KiB/1.5 MiB TP1; 8 KiB/384 KiB TP4) right; deepep_low_latency still gives 8192/1024: no use_batched_dp_moe branch and all2all_backend not forwarded.

Partial prefills emit nothing and prompt_tokens moves at first token; vllm:iteration_tokens_total, prompt_tokens_cached and prompt_tokens_by_source not modeled; no prefill_stats in scheduler outputs; num_preempted_reqs hardcoded 0.
